messages:
Priya Shah: Ok team — urgent: need final sign-off on APAC marketplace MDF pilot split. Finance wants numbers by Friday COB. This impacts QBR scorecards and partner tiers.
Ethan Li: Quick clarifying Q — is this solely for the cloud marketplace listing, or are we bundling hardware partner co-funds and SI enablement in the same pool?
Maya Torres: Bundling everything for this pilot so partners see a single offer. My proposal: marketplace / hardware / SI = 60 / 30 / 10 (percent). Link to draft sheet: https://tiny.redwood/apac-mdf (please review).
Samir Kapoor: Updated the sheet with regional CPM and expected signed ARR. https://tiny.redwood/apac-mdf (tab: assumptions). Numbers look tight in SEA unless we reallocate.
Priya Shah: Thinking out loud — SI deliverables aren't fully scoped yet. Can we consider shifting SI down and moving dollars into marketplace marketing to improve discovery?
Maya Torres: If SI drops <10% we lose onboarding velocity. Without SI work, conversion window goes up. @Ethan can you get SI lead input?
Ethan Li: Looping in SI leads now: tagging @Kenji and @Rina in the doc. Kenji responded: they need at least 10% to hit onboarding milestones otherwise ramp slips 6–8 weeks.
Kenji Nakamura: 10% is the floor. With 10% we can do a 3-week onboarding blitz; <10% and we need to add contractor hours (which increases ops cost).
Priya Shah: Ok compromise proposed: SI = 8%, hardware 26%, marketplace 66% — keeps most in go-to-market while giving SI something to start. Thoughts?
Maya Torres: That could work if SI accepts compressed scope and we commit a clear timeline. I'll flag deliverables on the doc.
Samir Kapoor: Finance needs the final line items. I'll format as: code block for clarity.
```
Total MDF = $120,000
Marketplace = 66% -> $79,200
Hardware = 26% -> $31,200
SI = 8% -> $9,600
```
Rina Gomez: I'll draft a one-page SOW template for the SI scope and a checklist for deliverables. Can we confirm milestone payments?
Priya Shah: Milestone payments: 25% on kickoff, 50% on delivery of enablement assets + training, 25% on 90-day completion and metrics review.
Maya Torres: :thumbsup: I'll update the QBR scorecard and the partner tier impact slide. Need the finalized numbers by Tue to get prep time.
Samir Kapoor: I'll submit the MDF request to finance with the above splits and milestone terms. Will include the sheet and SOW draft link.
Priya Shah: Final timeline: finalize by Fri 5pm PT so legal/finance can process next week. Thanks everyone — please add any objections in the doc by EOD tomorrow.
